R. solanacerum strains in China are mainly of Asian phylotype 1 and biovar 3:123, but a minority are of phylotype II and biovar 2; the BOX fingerprints of phylotype I are highly diverse, but some strains are host or site specific; all strains of phylotype 2 are of the sequevar 2.1.
